correctness.rationale: For exact minimization over all but omitted coordinate j, the residual is (e_jᵀe)H^-1 e_j/K_jj; its energy is (e_jᵀe)^2/K_jj. Gram reduction gives λmax(Q^{1/2}GQ^{1/2}). A sign-conjugated nonnegative Gram with r=G^-1 1>0 yields universal fixed-vector Rayleigh lower bound 1/R; q=r/R attains it by positive Perron eigenvector and is unique since equality forces Wq=Wq*. For H_c, direct matrix inversion gives signed G=[[1,s,s],[s,1,s²],[s,s²,1]] and q*=(1−s,1,1)/(3−s). Closed eigenvalues show opt<uniform<determinant law for all 0<s<1, with decrement ratio 4/3 near s→1. Independently computed spectra for s=.1,.5,.9 and verified signed Gram algebra; samples are not the universal proof.
